tone.target: tight djent metal with clean percussive attack

tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing an overdrive boost for attack, followed by a powerful Recti amp model into a 4x12 cabinet, ensuring maximum low-end definition and transient response.
corrections: favor amp gain over pedal fuzz
